normalized_claim: Higher genetically proxied lifetime smoking liability decreases multivariate longevity in European-ancestry populations.

comparator: lower genetically proxied lifetime smoking liability
outcome: multivariate longevity comprising health span, lifespan, and exceptional longevity
population_or_model: European-ancestry GWAS cohorts

estimand_or_contrast.statement: Change in multivariate longevity per unit increase in genetically proxied lifetime smoking liability.
estimand_or_contrast.effect_measure_or_logical_contrast: MR beta; primary MVMR estimate beta -0.33 with 95% CI -0.38 to -0.28

assumption_judgments.assessment: Multiple estimators, heterogeneity tests, confounder screening, directionality testing, and negative controls were reported.

FinnGen replication concerned psychiatric diagnoses, while the alternate smoking instrument and colocalization were internal sensitivity evidence rather than an independent replication of the same smoking-to-longevity contrast.

validations.description: Alternate nicotinic receptor gene-cluster instrument and colocalization supported the smoking-longevity association.

evidence_anchors.quote: This 2-sample mendelian randomization (MR) study assessed associations between psychiatric disorders, substance use behaviors, and longevity using single-variable and multivariable models.

evidence_anchors.section_heading: Associations of Psychiatric Disorders and Substance Use Behaviors With Longevity
evidence_anchors.quote: corroborated smoking-longevity associations

evidence_anchors.section_heading: Associations of Psychiatric Disorders and Substance Use Behaviors With Longevity
evidence_anchors.quote: Negative control analyses assessing the impact of the psychiatric disorders and substance use behaviors on self-reported tanning ability were null

reviewer_note: Assessable genetically proxied effect, not the effect of smoking cessation or a drug. No qualifying independent same-link replication was established from the main text.

normalized_claim: Genetic variants influence late-life egg production partly through uterus weight in aged laying hens.
exposure_operation: observational causal mediation decomposition with uterus weight as mediator
population_or_model: 254 Rhode Island Red laying hens measured at 100 weeks
time_horizon: single late-life assessment with retrospective egg count interval

estimand_or_contrast.statement: Average causal mediation effect of each SNP on late-life egg number through uterus weight.
estimand_or_contrast.effect_measure_or_logical_contrast: ACME and ADE from fitted mediation models

assumption_judgments.assessment: The report statistically decomposes same-cohort measurements but does not establish sequential ignorability for uterus weight and egg production.
Egg production covers weeks 85-100 and uterus weight is measured at week 100, so mediator precedence is not established.

evidence_anchors.quote: We analyzed a cohort of 254 Rhode Island Red laying hens at 100 weeks of age.

the total genetic effect on an outcome trait was decomposed into an indirect effect mediated by UW100 (average causal mediation effect, ACME) and a direct effect independent of UW100 (average direct effect, ADE)

reviewer_note: The formal mediation result is a directed hypothesis. Same-time observational mediator measurement and unaddressed mediation assumptions prevent an assessable mediated effect.

normalized_claim: Stabilized regression identifies age- or diet-dependent directed gene-to-pathway relationships in the BXD mouse liver multi-omics data.
exposure_operation: stabilized regression across genotype, age, and diet environments
comparator: changes in regression stability across independent environments
outcome: membership upstream or downstream of canonical metabolic pathways
population_or_model: 347 BXD mice from 58 isogenic strains

estimand_or_contrast.statement: Direction category for candidate gene-pathway associations under environment-dependent coefficient stability.
estimand_or_contrast.effect_measure_or_logical_contrast: upstream, downstream, or ambiguous stability classification

assumption_judgments.assessment: Orientation is based on coefficient stability across at least two independent variables.
The method output is a direction category and does not define an intervention effect.

evidence_anchors.quote: estimates whether the selected target is more likely to be upstream of a canonical pathway (i.e., causal), downstream (i.e., a biomarker), or ambiguous
stabilized regression can calculate the causality for associations that are impacted by two or more independent causal variables

reviewer_note: Formal direction inference, but no defined gene-intervention effect or sufficient causal assumptions. The later worm perturbations are separate claims.

normalized_claim: Loss of the Ctsd ortholog asp-4 shortens lifespan in C. elegans relative to wild type.

population_or_model: RB2035 asp-4 mutant and wild-type N2 worms

assumption_judgments.assessment: Mutant and wild-type worms were compared on the same empty-vector treatment.
The lifespan pattern was repeated in a complete experimental replicate.

validations.description: A complete experimental replicate confirmed the worm lifespan pattern.

evidence_anchors.section_heading: Aging candidate discovery and C. elegans validation
evidence_anchors.quote: has a significant decrease in lifespan compared with wild type

evidence_anchors.section_heading: Aging candidate discovery and C. elegans validation
evidence_anchors.quote: These patterns were confirmed in a complete experimental replicate

normalized_claim: TWAS conditional analysis and FOCUS prioritize genes that may causally influence epigenetic age acceleration or multivariate longevity.

comparator: lower genetically predicted expression of the indexed gene
outcome: epigenetic age acceleration or multivariate longevity

estimand_or_contrast.statement: Posterior prioritization of a gene within a TWAS locus, not an intervention effect.
estimand_or_contrast.effect_measure_or_logical_contrast: TWAS significance, conditional p-value, and FOCUS posterior inclusion probability

assumption_judgments.assessment: FOCUS ranks likely causal features within association loci but does not supply an intervention estimand for gene expression.

diagnostics.name: colocalization and permutation
diagnostics.result_or_role: Used as robustness checks for TWAS associations.

evidence_anchors.section_heading: TWASs reveal transcriptomic architecture of aging traits
evidence_anchors.quote: results of colocalization analyses

evidence_anchors.section_heading: Fine-mapping of TWAS associations and high confidence findings
evidence_anchors.quote: A PIP > 0.5 indicates that the feature is the most likely causal feature within a risk region

reviewer_note: FOCUS is a formal prioritization method, but causal wording and posterior ranking do not by themselves identify a gene-expression effect.

normalized_claim: Higher genetically proxied non-HDL cholesterol and related lipoprotein traits decrease multivariate longevity.

population_or_model: European-ancestry metabolomic and longevity GWAS cohorts

Complementary estimators, Steiger directionality, and MR-Lasso for heterogeneous instruments were reported.

evidence_anchors.quote: metabolome-wide MR analysis of 249 circulating metabolites
we performed two-sample MR analyses of 249 circulating metabolic phenotypes

reviewer_note: Assessable genetically proxied effect with explicit IV assumptions and diagnostics; no qualifying independent same-link replication was shown.

normalized_claim: Eight months of dasatinib plus quercetin treatment reduces histological and molecular features of kidney aging in aged male mice relative to vehicle.
exposure_operation: biweekly oral gavage from 12 to 20 months of age
outcome: kidney senescence, fibrosis, inflammation, lipid metabolism, and molecular aging readouts

estimand_or_contrast.statement: Between-group effect of long-term D+Q assignment versus vehicle on kidney tissue and molecular outcomes.
estimand_or_contrast.effect_measure_or_logical_contrast: group differences assessed by one-way ANOVA and multi-omics contrasts

assumption_judgments.assessment: Random-number allocation and investigator blinding were reported.
Renal function was not collected, so the claim is limited to tissue and molecular outcomes.

evidence_anchors.quote: Allocation to experimental groups was performed by random number tables
received biweekly oral gavage of the D + Qcocktail for a total duration of 8 months
the present work does not directly establish improvement in renal function

normalized_claim: Prolonged heterochronic parabiosis followed by detachment extends lifespan of old female mice compared with old isochronic parabiosis.
exposure_or_intervention: 3 months of heterochronic parabiosis with a young mouse followed by detachment
exposure_operation: shared circulation and physical attachment to a young partner
comparator: old-old isochronic parabiosis followed by detachment
population_or_model: 20-month-old female mice paired with young or old partners

estimand_or_contrast.statement: Difference in post-detachment survival between old heterochronic and old isochronic parabiosis groups.

assumption_judgments.assessment: Pairs were selected randomly after size screening, and investigators were blinded after detachment.
Parabiosis transfers a complex circulating package and imposes a surgical/physical procedure; it cannot identify a specific youthful factor.

validations.description: Independent methylation platforms supported epigenetic-age effects, but this is a different outcome in overlapping experimental groups.

evidence_anchors.quote: Mouse pairs were prescreened to minimize differences in body size but were otherwise chosen randomly.
We observed a 6-week extension in median lifespan and a 2-week extension in maximum lifespan in old mice detached from heterochronic pairs compared to their isochronic controls
Investigators were blinded to group allocations during the experiments and outcome assessments after detachment.

reviewer_note: The identified exposure is the heterochronic parabiosis package/procedure, not an individual circulating molecule.

normalized_claim: CRISPRi-mediated HOTAIRM1 deficiency impairs DNA repair and promotes p53-mediated cellular senescence.

outcome: DNA repair and cellular senescence phenotypes
population_or_model: K562, BJ, HEK293, and related cell models

estimand_or_contrast.statement: Difference in DNA-repair and senescence phenotypes after HOTAIRM1 knockdown versus non-targeting control.
estimand_or_contrast.effect_measure_or_logical_contrast: perturbation-group differences in multiome modules, DNA repair reporters, and senescence readouts

validations.description: AAV-mediated HOTAIRM1 overexpression improved aged mouse lung fibrosis and damage.

evidence_anchors.quote: Its deficiency impairs DNA repair and triggers p53-mediated senescence.
three independent sgRNAs (sg1-sg3) were designed and cloned into the CRISPRi vector backbone
adeno-associated virus-mediated HOTAIRM1 overexpression reduced fibrosis, alleviated tissue damage, and promoted cellular proliferation

reviewer_note: The cell perturbation is assessable. The in-vivo overexpression is biologically supportive but differs in operation, system, and endpoint and therefore is not Level 4 validation of this claim.

normalized_claim: Accelerated biological aging mediates associations between lifestyle behaviors and incident age-related disease risk in UK Biobank.
exposure_operation: structural-equation mediation analysis
outcome: incident cardiovascular, neurological, immune, or musculoskeletal disease
population_or_model: 30,376 UK Biobank participants
time_horizon: baseline omics with 5-, 10-, and 15-year disease follow-up

estimand_or_contrast.statement: Indirect association of lifestyle score with disease through a predicted aging-rate mediator.
estimand_or_contrast.effect_measure_or_logical_contrast: SEM path coefficients, Sobel test, and proportion mediated

assumption_judgments.assessment: Proteomic and metabolomic measurements were cross-sectional, precluding direct assessment of within-person aging dynamics.
The SEM description does not address sequential ignorability or exposure-induced mediator-outcome confounding.

evidence_anchors.quote: we performed mediation analysis using structural equation modeling (SEM)
the cross-sectional design of the proteomic and metabolomic measurements precludes the direct assessment of intra-individual aging dynamics

reviewer_note: Prospective disease follow-up does not by itself identify the mediator path because lifestyle and predicted biological aging remain observational and key mediation assumptions are unaddressed.

normalized_claim: Systemic inflammatory genes and pathways mediate the association between subclinical atherosclerosis and accelerated Grim epigenetic age.

population_or_model: 391 middle-aged asymptomatic PESA participants

estimand_or_contrast.statement: Average causal mediation effect of inflammatory transcript or protein markers between subclinical atherosclerosis and epigenetic age acceleration.
estimand_or_contrast.effect_measure_or_logical_contrast: ACME adjusted for traditional cardiovascular risk factors

assumption_judgments.assessment: The authors invoke sequential ignorability based on matching, but residual mediator-outcome and exposure-outcome confounding cannot be ruled out.
The paper explicitly states that the study design cannot establish a causal effect between atherosclerosis and epigenetic age acceleration.

evidence_anchors.quote: Model-based causal mediation analysis was performed.
does not allow to establish a causal effect

reviewer_note: The explicit causal mediation model supports a directed hypothesis, while the authors' own limitation and observational covariation preclude an assessable mediated effect.

FMT identifies the effect of the aged microbial package, not B. pseudolongum or IAA individually.

evidence_anchors.quote: A group of young recipient mice (8-­ week-­ old) were transplanted gut microbiota from naturally aged mice (100-­ week-­ old) for a continued 12 weeks

Placebo n =  9, losartan treatment n =  7.
